cases.title: Deleting a seeded type is refused (Db2 SQLCODE -532, child categories) and the row stays; the message ends 'DSNTIAC CD12' because INITIALIZE zeroes the DSNTIAC message-area length
cases.source: COTRTLIC 9300-DELETE-RECORD SQLCODE = -532 keeps CA-DELETE-REQUESTED; next ENTER rereads the row; COTRTLIC 0000-MAIN INITIALIZE WS-MISC-STORAGE zeroes WS-DSNTIAC-MESG-LEN, so DSNTIAC returns 12 (area under 240 bytes) and CSDB2RPY appends 'DSNTIAC CD' + the code
